name: The Great Outdoors

angles.text: As a cook, learning to make camp gives you a foundation for preparing meals in the open air.
As a hunter, living off the land and resting by an open flame may feel familiar. Even seasoned scouts benefit from learning campcraft.

faq.answer: Sam is an experienced outdoorsman and traveler who teaches newcomers to endure the wild. He welcomes them to share his fire and learn practical ways to face the road.
Boosted Rest is the renewal that comes from resting beside a proper campfire in the wild. Its warmth and comfort help weary travelers recover and continue their journey.
faq.q: What is the purpose of sitting by the campfire?

faq.answer: Wilderness skills help travelers endure the dangers and long miles beyond settlement walls. Fieldcraft lets them sustain themselves without succumbing to fatigue.
faq.q: Why are wilderness skills important for adventurers?

faq.answer: After you learn to make a basic camp, profession trainers can teach you to craft camp fixtures suited to your work in the field.
faq.q: How do tradeskills relate to wilderness camping?

faq.answer: After resting by Sam’s fire and learning basic campcraft, you can seek out profession trainers. A practical craft lets you build field stations suited to your trade.
faq.q: What should an adventurer do after completing this lesson?

faq.answer: Any traveler setting out into the wider world can learn these lessons, whatever their background or allegiance.
faq.q: Who can undertake The Great Outdoors?

sections.body: Sam welcomes restless travelers who cross Azeroth in search of fortune, danger, and renown. Ambition alone cannot keep a newcomer warm or ease the miles. By his fire, you learn when to rest, how to build a fire, and how to gather strength for the open road.
sections.title: Lessons by the Fire

sections.body: A campfire offers warmth against the night chill and a chance for boosted rest. Those who know the wild understand that endurance comes from resting between journeys. Once you have learned these basics, you can turn to tradeskills. Craftsmen and gatherers can learn to make camp fixtures suited to their work in the field.
sections.title: Fieldcraft and Trade

summary: At Sam’s fire, travelers learn to rest and endure the road. Then they can turn to tradeskills and work in the wild.
